sloka: अपि गोदावरीम् सीता पद्मानि आनयितुम् गता ।एवम् उक्तः तु रामेण लक्ष्मणः पुनः एव हि ॥३-६४-२॥
transliteration: api godāvarīm sītā padmāni ānayitum gatā ।evam uktaḥ tu rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇaḥ punaḥ eva hi ॥3-64-2॥

translations.english: Lakshmana, destroyer of enemywarriors, went to the beautiful river Godavari with quick steps following the instruction of Rama.
